raw.rationale: Tozasertib is a pan-Aurora kinase inhibitor with potent activity against AURKA/B/C and additional targets (Bcr-Abl, FLT3, JAK, LCK), and PRISM single-concentration screens of Aurora inhibitors typically show selective sensitivity in hematologic lineages (not listed here) and in subsets of solid tumors with high Aurora kinase dependency or MYC/MYCN amplification, such as neuroblastoma and some lung/breast cancers; however, at 2.5 µM for 5 days, broad cytotoxicity and efflux by ABC transporters reduce lineage-selective killing, so most solid lineages have low probabilities near the base rate.
